title: Apple to skip high-end M6 Mac chips in favor of AI-focused M7 line
summary: Apple is reportedly skipping high-end M6 Mac chips and will instead launch an AI-focused M7 line with Pro, Max, and Ultra variants, signaling a strategic pivot toward prioritizing artificial intelligence capabilities in its next-generation Mac processors.
problem_solved: Apple is addressing the growing demand for AI-capable personal computing by repositioning its Mac chip roadmap to emphasize on-device AI processing over traditional performance increments.
why_valuable: This strategic shift demonstrates Apple's commitment to making Macs first-class AI platforms, potentially offering users powerful on-device AI capabilities without relying on cloud services.
